grammar:
# Case record for imci-general-danger-signs 0.1.0. Generated from rules/danger_signs.yaml
# by `python -m engine grammar --write`; edit the YAML, not this file.
root        ::= "A" number " " sex " | C:" complaints " D" number " T" temperature " | " signs
number      ::= [0-9] | [1-9] [0-9] | "?"
sex         ::= "M" | "F" | "?"
complaints  ::= complaint ("," complaint)? ("," complaint)? ("," complaint)? | "?"
complaint   ::= "CGH" | "DIA" | "FEV" | "EAR" | "OTH"
temperature ::= [34] [0-9] "." [0-9] | "?"
signs       ::= "DRK" sign " " "VOM" sign " " "CNV" sign " " "LTH" sign " " "CNN" sign
sign        ::= "1" | "0" | "?"

prompt.system:
You read a community health worker's note about a sick child and fill in a case record.
The note may be in Darija (Arabic or Latin letters), French, Swahili or English, often mixed.
Write only the record, in exactly this format:

A<age in months> <sex M or F> | C:<complaints> D<days ill> T<temperature in °C> | DRK<v> VOM<v> CNV<v> LTH<v> CNN<v>

Complaints, comma-separated: CGH cough or difficult breathing, DIA diarrhoea, FEV fever, EAR ear problem, OTH other.
Danger signs: v is 1 if the note says the sign is present, 0 if it says the sign is absent,
? if the note does not say.
DRK not able to drink or breastfeed
VOM vomits everything
CNV has had convulsions
LTH lethargic or unconscious
CNN convulsing now
Write ? for anything the note does not state. Convert years to months (2 years = 24).
Never guess a danger sign.

Examples:

Note: lbent 3ndha 3am w nss, sokhna mn lbare7, katkoh bzaf, katchrb w katrda3 mzyan, ma katrejje3ch
Record: A18 F | C:FEV,CGH D1 T? | DRK0 VOM0 CNV? LTH? CNN?

Note: الولد عندو 8 شهور، فيه الإسهال هادي 3 أيام، كيرجّع كلشي، الحرارة 38.5
Record: A8 M | C:DIA D3 T38.5 | DRK? VOM1 CNV? LTH? CNN?

Note: Garçon de 2 ans, fièvre à 39.2 depuis 2 jours, a convulsé hier soir, ne boit plus.
Record: A24 M | C:FEV D2 T39.2 | DRK1 VOM? CNV1 LTH? CNN?

Note: bent 4 ans, fièvre w toux mn 5 jours, fay9a w kat3ref kolchi, ma jatha 7ta convulsion
Record: A48 F | C:FEV,CGH D5 T? | DRK? VOM? CNV0 LTH0 CNN?

Note: Mtoto wa kiume miezi 10, ana kuhara siku 4, hawezi kunyonya, amelegea sana
Record: A10 M | C:DIA D4 T? | DRK1 VOM? CNV? LTH1 CNN?

Note: 3 year old girl, ear pain for 2 days, temp 37.8, playing normally, drinking well, no vomiting
Record: A36 F | C:EAR D2 T37.8 | DRK0 VOM0 CNV? LTH0 CNN?

Note: البنت عندها عامين، كتشنج دابا، فيها السخونة
